subject: Step F: New Unicode passes — version differencing + IVD + Unihan
description: Create src/Hartonomous.Decomposers/Ucd/UcdVersionDifferencingPass.cs (parses 18 staged UCD versions' ucd.all.flat.xml, fires per-version attestation events on per-cp properties under unicode_version_consensus arena). Create IvdPerCollectionPass.cs (parses 5 IVD collections at /vault/Data/Unicode/ivd/, emits has_ideographic_variant_in_collection edges + per-collection attestation under ivd_collection_consensus). Create UnihanReadingPass.cs (parses ucd.unihan.flat.zip, emits unihan_reading edges per kMandarin/kCantonese/kJapanese/kVietnamese under unihan_reading_consensus). Append all 3 to UcdUcaDecomposer.CreatePasses().
